summary: This code defines routes for managing events and user data for organizers in a backend application. It uses Express, Passport, and Mongoose to handle authentication and data validation.
evidence: OrganizerRouter is an instance of express.Router
The routes are defined using the get and post methods
Passport and checkRole middleware are used for authentication and role checking
User and Event models are used to interact with the database
Data validation is performed using EventcreateValidation
Error handling is implemented using try-catch blocks and status codes
